title.zh: 免费 VPN 透明代理与 DNS 劫持实录：个人凭证、Cookie 与信用卡信息被窃取的技术链条
title.en: Transparent Proxy & DNS Hijacking in Free VPNs: How Cookies, Credentials, and Cards Are Stolen

cluster.zh: 免费 VPN 风险雷达与供应链剖析

description.zh: 通过抓包实录深度拆解恶意免费代理软件如何通过伪造根证书（CA Certificate Injection）、强制 DNS 污染与透明代理中间人劫持，窃取用户明文登录凭据与金融会话 Cookie。
description.en: Packet-level analysis of rogue free VPNs using root CA injection, DNS poison redirection, and transparent MITM proxies to harvest cleartext credentials, cookies, and payment information.
